quests.title: Returns at Sefton
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I am sending back 74 papers a day from Sefton and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Sefton
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. They will drop my Sefton order if I can show $109 of turnover on the other side of the shop by Thursdays. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $109, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Sefton Round
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I do the Sefton round from the back of seven and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Sefton
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. There is a dog on the Sefton round that has had two of my bags and a bucket of odd keys that was not even mine. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Sefton
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Nine of us at Sefton have gone in on the same numbers since Thursdays and one of us has stopped putting money in. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$74, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Sefton
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The agency at Chester Hill closed six months before Sefton started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me

quests.title: The Unclaimed Falcon, Central
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. There has been a car in the Central yard since a Tuesday with a laminated notice on the passenger seat and no owner answering. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the car and the plate together
I have to prove I tried before I can move it

quests.title: Storage Fees, Central
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Now that it is documented, Central is owed $77 in storage and the only person who can pay it is the person not answering. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $77, from him or from the scrap
either way it comes off my floor

quests.title: First Year, Central
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I am in my first year at Central and I have to log 96 hours on a job I am not allowed to touch on my own. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the supplier, two streets over
and get him a coffee, it helps
sign the book and I owe you

quests.title: The Air Line, Central
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Somebody has been coming into the Central yard after the back of seven to use the air line, and last week they used the compressor as well. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the ones who think the yard is public
the gate they are getting through

quests.title: My Own Car, Central
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. My car has been at Central since a Tuesday and every time I ring, the quote has grown by about $96. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: stand in the office where they can see you
the job card on the wall, all of it
now I know what I am arguing about

quests.title: The Assessor, Central
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The insurance assessor who signs off every job at Central works out of Museum, and he has never once seen the car he is assessing. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: catch him before he goes out on the road
I want to hear how he does it

quests.title: Dumped Out the Back, Belmore
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. People leave things at the Belmore roller door after first light and by morning it is rained on and it is our problem and our tip fee. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the pile, on a bad morning
the council will not act without one of these

quests.title: The Tip Fee, Belmore
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. The photos worked, which means Belmore can claim back the $84 we have paid to throw away other people's furniture since the first of the month. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $84, and every receipt counts
I will do the form if you do the walking

quests.title: The Good Box, Belmore
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Something came into Belmore on the first of the month in a box of paperbacks that I do not think the family meant to give away. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the address on the donation slip
the thing itself, before it goes back
I would rather give it back than sell it

quests.title: Sorting Room, Belmore
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Two people have been coming into the Belmore sorting room since the first of the month and taking the good stock before it reaches the floor, and one of them volunteers here. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: catch them at the back door
$10, which is what the good stock made last month

quests.title: The Van, Belmore
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. I do the Belmore pick-ups in a van with 10 thousand on it and a door that only opens if you know about it. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: come out to Lakemba with me, it is a two-person lift
we will stop on the way, my shout

quests.title: Head Office, Belmore
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Everything Belmore cannot sell goes to a warehouse at Lakemba, and nobody there has ever answered a phone in my hearing. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: turn up in person, that is the trick
tell me there is a person in there
